optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Operations Specialist, Insurance Claims Platform

professionalSummary.text: Owns the supplier panel end-to-end, from tender through rate sign-off to performance review, with delegated authority for panel rates.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the tender file for the regional repair and inspection panel: supplier questionnaires, the scoring template and the comparison sheet that the procurement manager and the claims director used in the award meeting. Panel rates were negotiated by the procurement manager; my part was collating supplier proposals, checking them against the rate card and drafting the award letters for signature. Responsibilities included tender file preparation, performance-pack compilation, proposal collation and end-of-cycle documentation for the claims supplier panel over about three years.

experienceHighlights.text: Runs the tender cycle for repair, inspection and loss-adjusting services and maintains the tender file.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the tender file for the regional repair and inspection panel: supplier questionnaires, the scoring template and the comparison sheet that the procurement manager and the claims director used in the award meeting. Responsibilities included tender file preparation, performance-pack compilation, proposal collation and end-of-cycle documentation for the claims supplier panel over about three years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Prepares supplier performance reviews from claims data and records the outcomes.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Compiled quarterly supplier performance packs from claims cycle-time and complaint data and presented them at the review meeting, where the procurement manager decided on warnings or removals.

skills.text: Coordinates panel changes with claims operations and legal and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Wrote the end-of-cycle note after each tender, listing suppliers still under probation, open contract clauses and the hand-over items for the contract administrator. Responsibilities included tender file preparation, performance-pack compilation, proposal collation and end-of-cycle documentation for the claims supplier panel over about three years.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate owns the supplier panel end-to-end, runs the tender cycle, prepares performance reviews, and coordinates panel changes. However, they do not establish that the candidate has signed off panel rates or documented known limitations at the end of each tender cycle.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate has strong evidence for most requirements but lacks evidence for signing off panel rates and documenting known limitations at the end of each tender cycle.
